description: This file defines a benchmark class 'StructDeserializeBenchmark' that compares the performance of deserializing a specific struct 'IntStruct' using various serialization libraries in C#. It includes setup for multiple serializers, static input data, and benchmark methods for each serializer to measure and compare their performance in deserializing 'IntStruct' instances.

classes.name: StructDeserializeBenchmark
classes.description: A benchmarking class to test and compare deserialization performance of 'IntStruct' across multiple serialization libraries using BenchmarkDotNet.

methods.name: SumResult
methods.description: Calculates the sum of the properties of the 'IntStruct' instance.

methods.name: Orleans
methods.description: Performs deserialization of 'IntStruct' using Orleans serializer and returns the sum of its properties.

methods.name: Utf8Json
methods.description: Deserializes 'IntStruct' using Utf8Json and returns the sum of its properties.

methods.name: SystemTextJson
methods.description: Deserializes 'IntStruct' using System.Text.Json and returns the sum of its properties.

methods.name: ZeroFormatter
methods.description: Deserializes 'IntStruct' using ZeroFormatter. (this method is currently commented out in benchmarks)
